verdict.reason: The source says the pipeline "detected nearly 80% of major space-weather events" in the evaluation period, with a 76.5% detection rate for major events (≥10 nT/min), not all geomagnetic storms. It also reports different rates for severe (81.2%) and extreme (64.1%) events, so "about 80% of geomagnetic storm events" overstates and blurs the figure.
